title: Drug Testing
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight initiates an investigation after finding half a joint in the parking lot, leading to tensions over drug use and testing in the office. Michael initially mocks the situation but later insists on drug testing, causing conflicts with Dwight and others. Dwight resigns from his security role after feeling he broke an oath but is then promoted to an official security supervisor. Throughout, relationships and suspicions about drug use create conflict and uncertainty among the staff.

main_threads.thread: Michael's fluctuating stance on drug testing, from mocking Dwight to cancelling and then reinstating drug tests, leading to office conflict and personal challenges.
